data: What is the approximate value of the green line at epoch 5 in Figure 6 (a)?

The green line represents Softmax(LR=2), and the red line represents Softmax(LR=3). The question asks for the approximate value of the green line at epoch 5 in Figure 6(a). From the graph, we can see that the green line starts at a high value and decreases over time. At epoch 5, the green line appears to be around 1000 on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate value of the green line at epoch 5 is 1000.
